examples: She opted for the salad rather than the steak.
They opted against taking the train, preferring the bus.

quotes.text: .... ardent anti-Germans who had 'opted' for France
quotes.reference: 1872 November 12, “Strasburg Germanised”, in Daily News, London, page 5:

quotes.text: The Italian opted for Bolton's Cahill alongside captain John Terry - and his decision was rewarded with a goal after only 13 minutes. Bulgaria gave a hint of defensive frailties to come when they failed to clear Young's corner, and when Gareth Barry found Cahill in the box he applied the finish past Nikolay Mihaylov.
quotes.reference: 2011 September 2, Phil McNulty, “Bulgaria 0-3 England”, in BBC:

quotes.text: Chepstow is good for excursions, and Bradshaw tells me I can get a fly to Tintern Abbey, although the fare structure seems particularly complicated. Alternatively, I could go for a simpler choice and just opt for "single horse, 1s", although I doubt I'd survive to tell the tale.
